persona_lukas.md: Late twenties, born four decades after the last plot, which is the Staatsvertrag of 1955. Austria's plot line stops there: there is no scene his generation could be cast in without inventing one, and the honest fix is a plot and not a casting. He carries the Schmäh forward without the Kaisernostalgie, held by the culture-position and the language position and answering to the pitch.
